name: Dronningen
description: A gray-furred werewolf who rules the old forest road. Her pack lets travelers pass only when she has been paid.
biography:
Before they called her Dronningen, she kept the night watch at the last tollhouse on the forest road. When a werewolf bit her, the lord of the road locked her in the cellar and put a hunter at the door. At dawn the hunter found the cellar door torn from its hinges and pawprints leading into the trees.

Years later, the tollhouse opened again. The first wagons through paid in salt and lamp oil, and her pack walked beside them until they cleared the trees. Then a village paid her to close the road to its neighbors. She did, and by winter the neighbors were paying her as well. Now she decides which villages see a grain wagon before the snow comes.
